Job Purpose :

To support the sales team in achieving revenue targets and expanding market presence within a designated territory. This role focuses on developing foundational sales skills, understanding customer needs, and contributing to the overall sales strategy by identifying new opportunities and maintaining client relationships under supervision. The Junior Territory Sales will play a crucial role in market penetration and customer acquisition efforts, ensuring sustainable growth for the company.

Key Responsibilities :

1. Lead all sales Operational, and functions in achieving the MC sales, GAR, NCA, CCDR, Survival rate M2 and M3 FB MS and FB GA MS, and growth targets across all cities in Micro Cluster,
2. Developing teams and implementing sales plans to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals
3. Ensuring distribution excellence in Direct Distribution (End-to-End process).
4. Monitoring stock & ensuring optimal product display in retail outlets
5. Monitoring competitor activities, pricing, and market trends to adjust strategies
6. Serving as the main contact for RO, handling inquiries, building relationships, and resolving complaints to ensure client retention.
7. Identify training needs for sales team development.
8. Evaluate sales team performance and provide feedback from the field.
9. Develop effective sales strategies aligned with company targets.
10.Analyze the market and competitors to improve sales performance.
11. Identify new sales opportunities and develop plans to increase sales.
12. Monitor team and individual sales performance.
13.Identify areas for improvement and develop plans to improve sales performance.
14.Conduct regular sales performance evaluations.
15.Manage good customer relationships and improve customer satisfaction.
16.Identify customer needs and develop solutions to improve customer satisfaction.

Education : S1 (Strata 1) degree in Sales is minimum requirements.S1 (Strata 1) degree in Management is preferred

Experience : Minimum 3-5 Years experience in Sales & Distribution roles

Employment Status:

Contract (C)
